hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. Each hook instance is a delegatecall proxy. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, enforces a custom curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully handle swap accounting — replacing standard CLAMM liquidity with vault-backed liquidity.
